executionBounds.failurePolicy: Stop on missing cache/fixture or failed baseline/prerequisite; preserve named behavioral mutant failures as expected controls. nextReviewScope: Exact artifact commit plus current source/test byte equality, count/event reconstruction, mutation/restoration, prerequisite/cleanup proof. Inherit R2-01..02 and prior independently completed product checks; repeat only after a new failure/concern.
